item.title: What Swift's Collections Actually Cost: Buffers, Hashing, and the O(n) You Didn't See
item.description:
Everyone knows Array, Dictionary, and Set. You learned them in week one. The interesting part is not the API. It is the cost model underneath, and the places where a line of code that looks O(1) is quietly O(n), or where a loop that looks fine is O(n²) and your profile flatlines a frame.

That is the part that bites in production. So let’s look at what these three actually do at runtime.
